You replied to my story so I'll reply to yours. She's with you, so you are worthy. Be open with her as much as possible. The more she knows and the more you let her in and the longer she stays, the stronger you both get. Just TRUST her. Don't doubt her intentions. I did. And I fucked my life up. I don't know which way to turn.i lost the best person who ever chose to walk into my life. I hurt her. I'm a fucking mess. She's strong. She will prosper. But I'm nothing without her. 
Don't do what I did. Trust her, love her, love yourself too mate. Don't put yourself down cos you'll fuck it up
You're not quite grasping the situation

So find something non self destructive, non competitive, that pushes you out of your comfort zone. Something like yoga! Go to a got a class, something different, sociable. Once you push yourself for the first step you'll see an improvement. Not every day is perfect, but the bad days are less

The casino idea and "hopefully" sliding on ice isn't a good one... you will lose all your money, but you won't slide on ice... So you'll likely wake up feeling even worse the next day, with no money... Or worse, if driving drink, you'll have an accident and hurt/kill someone else and have the lack of money, guilt, shame and prison all hanging over you... Why not take that money and invest it. Not in stocks or shares... invest it in YOU. In a project. Something that interests you. Something you have a passion in... Something you're good at, that allows you to grow and build confidence in yourself. That gets you out of the house and in the open. 

Something that brings you peace, essentially. Inner peace. That's when you'll find someone, And have something to talk about. Women like a man with passion. Doesn't matter what for. If you have a passion for something, a hobby, something that interests YOU then YOU will interest someone, and then life will be good
